title: Document Compare 1.21.24
notes:
Document Compare 1.21.24 improves PDF reading reliability, expands explicit GPO comparisons and reduces unsupported review questions.

PDF reading review compares ordered words, insertions, omissions, punctuation, numbers and Roman references. Exact source-bound confirmations support Previous, Current, Digest and instructions; stale forms cannot change a replacement upload. Unresolved referenced-bill readings retain needs-review amendment results.

Selected literal checks address all 17 prioritized GPO candidate groups: date/year/time/decimal examples, spelling preference, compound plurals and nominal compounds, complete printed names, and full-name definitions for standard/IT abbreviations, units, Latin expressions, elements, dated currency codes and military ranks. The exact lumber designation protects its figures and checks the expressly prohibited multiplication sign. LCB retains priority. Bare abbreviations, arbitrary modifiers, identity, meaning and conditional table rows are not inferred.

All 219 prior review questions were individually reconciled against original sources. Concrete source/context guards make 137 quiet; one becomes the explicit Schedule correction; 81 remain review questions. All 138 prior precise findings remain, giving 139 precise findings and 81 questions across 23 fresh bill models / 2,024 pages. No new review questions were introduced. Final mapping was recomputed from raw NLP responses only after complete model/preparation/engine fingerprints matched. All 34 original PDFs retain their hashes.

Validation: all 3,181 source tests pass. The actual staged Windows EXE passes six workflows: GPO (17 exact findings, 29 quiet controls, 13 guide pages); accuracy (nine intended findings, 19 quiet controls); original AB 1967 Digest/eight amendments including comma insertion, in-kind and alignment; original AB 2266 ten amendments, zero style findings and stale-confirmation protection; controlled Previous/Current/Digest reading confirmations; and external-reference OCR uncertainty/original-page opening.

The 81 remaining questions require human adjudication. GPO conditional/contextual remainders, unavailable drafting materials and complete licensed ordered dictionary authority retain their documented manual limits. These checks do not certify human precision/recall, full LCB/GPO compliance, current legal/entity identity or statutory section validity.

Extract the entire Windows ZIP and open Document Compare/Document Compare.exe. Keep all runtime and resources together. PDF and language processing run locally. Existing manuals, offline engines, licenses and notices are retained. A SHA-256 sidecar accompanies the ZIP.
